item.title: Missouri Task Force 1 will not deploy to Gulf Coast for hurricane recovery
item.description:
Missouri Task Force 1 will not be deployed south to assist in Hurricane Isaias recovery, Boone County Fire Protection District Assistant Chief Chuck Doss said Saturday morning.

As the hurricane approached the U.S. Gulf Coast on Friday, BCFPD announced that Task Force 1 had been put on “alert” by FEMA, should federal assistance be requested.

“Team members and specialized equipment are prepared for potential deployment,” a Friday press release read.

Around 7:30 a.m. on Saturday, Doss said FEMA canceled the "alert" status.

The post Missouri Task Force 1 will not deploy to Gulf Coast for hurricane recovery appeared first on ABC17NEWS.
